text: Three men, sealed in a cave by a giant rock.
Their only way out: one deed done only for Allah. Which deed would you name... before you lose your chance?
The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, told us they said: only a deed done for Allah alone can save us now.
The first said: O Allah, I never let anyone drink before my old parents. One night they slept... and I held their milk until dawn.
If I did that for You... then move this rock.
The second said: O Allah, I left a sin, only out of fear of You.
It moved again... still not enough.
The third said: O Allah, I grew a worker's forgotten wage into a whole herd... and gave him all of it.
If I did that for You... then move this rock.
And the rock rolled away... and they walked out into the light.
A good deed no one sees... Allah sees. Do one today, only for Him.
